About the Position

Water4All 2026 Joint Transnational Call for research and innovation projects on "Sustainable Water Management" (excluding extreme events and circularity). 32 Funding Organisations from 30 countries all over Europe and beyond are participating. This PhD / postdoctoral opening at Water4All Partnership centres on Water4All 2026 Joint Transnational Call - Sustainable Water Management. The work sits within Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Climate Change. The role is based in Paris, France. The opportunity is fully funded; financial support is listed as Varies by participating funding organisation.. The stated deadline is 10 November 2026.

Type of Action

Calls

Duration

September 2026 – End 2031

Budget

Approx. €34 million

Scope and Objectives

In line with the strategic objectives of Water4All, the results should contribute to the implementation of evidence-based, global, EU and national water management policies and strategies, within the frameworks of the European Green Deal, the zero-pollution action plan, the Water Framework Directive and the two daughter directives on groundwater and quality of surface water, the Just Transition Mechanism, the European Water Resilience Strategy and the Sustainable Development Goals. Proposals should show cognisance of appropriate legislation and policy frameworks that are relevant for the call at national and international levels.

The context for the general call topics is described in Theme III of the Water4All Strategic Research and Innovation Agenda, "Integrated water management".

Call Topics

  • Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM)
  • River Basin Management
  • Groundwater Management
  • Water Resilience
  • Integrated Water Monitoring and data management
  • Water-positive solutions

About Water4All Partnership

The Water4All Partnership is a European research and innovation partnership focused on water security. It connects participating funders and organisations to support research addressing water-related challenges. Its activities include collaborative funding calls and knowledge exchange, helping link scientific research with approaches to sustainable water management, environmental protection and societal needs.

Official website: https://www.water4all-partnership.eu

International Informative Webinar

A general and informative webinar dedicated to the international researchers' community and presented in English was organised on 17 September 2026 (14:00-16:00 CEST). The webinar was recorded and slides are available.

Partnering Tool

A partner search tool is available for those looking for a partner or project.

Additional Modalities

Additional modalities for Early Career Researchers are included.

Eligibility and Requirements

Eligibility criteria are defined by the Water4All 2026 Joint Transnational Call. Researchers must check with their national funding organisation for specific eligibility rules. 32 funding organisations from 30 countries are participating.

Important Notes

  • Preproposal deadline: 10 November 2026, 15:00 CET.
  • Full proposal deadline: 6 April 2027, 15:00 CEST.
  • Approx. €34M budget.
  • 32 funding organisations from 30 countries.
  • Co-funded by the European Union.
  • Part of Water4All – Water Security for the Planet.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 10 November 2026, 15:00 CET (pre-proposal stage). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
